title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 里，最值得注意的不是又多了几个 AI 功能，而是工作方式和基础设施都在换挡：agent 开始后台持续工作，甚至彼此调用；网页流量和部署也越来越由 agent 驱动。另一条线索更务实：模型价格下降未必主要靠 open-weight，真正推动变化的是蒸馏、基础设施效率和供应商竞争。

archive.title: Agent 换挡日报
archive.desc: Agent 正从聊天窗口进入后台工作流，重塑 token 消耗、网页流量和产品基础设施，而模型成本下降仍来自多条效率曲线叠加。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-10-10 source feeds.

sections.title: Agents Become the Default Interface / Agent 成为默认入口
sections.desc: 今天的几个信号指向同一件事：人不再是每一步操作的发起者，agent 正在接管连续工作和软件入口。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch says the web is already becoming an agent-shaped medium: 58.18% of traffic across Vercel was bot-originated over the last 30 days, more than 60% of deployments are now agentic, and up to 83% of pageviews on Vercel's documentation sites come from agents. His conclusion is deliberately extreme: direct human traffic may become a rounding error, while the web is built for and by agents.
original:
Across the entire Vercel network, 58.18% traffic is bot-originated (last 30d). This was 32% in Jan 2024.

60%+ of deployments on Vercel are now agentic, up from ~3% in Jan 2026.

Up to 83% of pageviews are now coming from agents to Vercel's own documentation sites. The % reliably increases the more we optimize content for them.

I expect 'direct' human internet traffic to basically become a rounding error in coming years. The web will thrive, but it will be built for and by agents.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 说，网页已经开始变成 agent 形状的媒介：过去 30 天 Vercel 全网 58.18% 的流量来自 bot，超过 60% 的部署由 agent 参与，Vercel 自家文档站最多 83% 的 pageview 也来自 agent。他的判断很激进：几年后，人类直接访问网页的流量可能只剩四舍五入的误差，网页会由 agent 构建，也服务于 agent。
original: Vercel 全网 58.18% 的流量来自 bot（过去30天），2024年1月是32%。超过60%的部署现在由agent完成，2026年1月约3%。Vercel文档站最多83%的页面浏览来自agent。未来几年，‘直接’的人类互联网流量基本会变成四舍五入的误差。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie expects agent swarms and background agents to consume 1,000 times more tokens than people prompting one agent at a time. Chat-style AI will look like a relic because the dominant pattern will be agents doing continuous work inside our workflows, which also implies a much larger infrastructure and compute build-out.
original:
Agents spawning other agents, agents operating in the background on every task, and agent swarms will consume 1,000X more tokens than people prompting agents 1 at a time.

The usage of AI as a chat system that can only work for you at the pace that you can prompt it will seem like a relic within a year or two.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 预计，agent 互相派生、后台运行和 agent swarm 消耗的 token，会是人类一次次提示单个 agent 的 1000 倍。聊天式 AI 很快会像旧时代产品，因为主流模式将变成 agent 在工作流里持续干活，而这也意味着基础设施和算力建设还远未到头。
original: agent生成其他agent、agent在每个任务后台运行、agent swarm消耗的token会是人类一次提示一个agent的1000倍。一两年内，只能按人类提示速度工作的聊天式AI会像遗物一样。

rewrite: Rauch also points to a more concrete version of the agent economy: agents are already buying infrastructure products and services through Vercel's marketplace and CLI, and domains are next. The interesting shift is not that agents can generate code, but that they can now take a project from idea to an online business and transact along the way.
original:
Agents purchasing infrastructure products and services. We've been shocked by how often they buy from our marketplace via our CLI already. We're now extending this to domains.

Agents can now go full stack, from idea to online business, with a banger domain name 😁

rewrite: Rauch 还给出了 agent 经济更具体的一面：agent 已经在通过 Vercel marketplace 和 CLI 购买基础设施产品与服务，下一步是域名。变化不只是 agent 能写代码，而是它们开始能从一个想法一路走到线上业务，并在途中完成真实交易。
original: agent正在购买基础设施产品和服务。它们已经通过我们的CLI频繁从marketplace购买，频率让我们震惊。现在我们把域名也接进来。agent现在可以全栈地从想法走到线上业务，再配一个很棒的域名。

sections.title: The New Coding Loop / 新的写代码循环
sections.desc: 开发者的操作单元正在从手写代码转向提示、补全提示，再到让 agent 自动完成更多连续步骤。

rewrite: Nan Yu describes a progression in coding interfaces: first people wrote code by hand, then they tab-completed code, then they prompted agents, and now they can tab-complete the prompts themselves. The important change is that the unit being accelerated is no longer just code; it is the instruction layer that directs the agent.
original:
First we wrote code by hand, then we tab-completed the code.

Then we evolved to prompting agents…and now we tab-complete that too.

rewrite: Nan Yu 描述了一条很清晰的 coding interface 演化路径：先是手写代码，再用 tab 补全代码，然后开始给 agent 写 prompt，现在连 prompt 都可以被补全。被加速的对象已经不只是代码，而是指挥 agent 的指令层。
original: 先手写代码，然后tab补全代码。后来进化到给agent写prompt，现在连prompt也可以补全。

rewrite: Thariq says a side project that needed a constantly running Agent SDK process and was unreliable with Opus 4 became much more reliable after one prompt ported it to Claude Managed Agents with Opus 5.5. It is a small but telling example of managed agent infrastructure removing the operational burden that used to sit around an otherwise capable model.
original:
before I joined Anthropic, I spent about 2 weeks hacking on this as a side project with Opus 4. It used the Agent SDK so it needed a constantly running process & didnt work that well

but one prompt to Opus 5.5 ported it to Claude Managed Agents & made it way more reliable

rewrite: Thariq 说，他加入 Anthropic 前用 Opus 4 做过一个副项目：依赖 Agent SDK，需要常驻进程，运行并不稳定。后来只用一个 prompt，就把它迁移到 Opus 5.5 的 Claude Managed Agents 上，可靠性大幅提升。这里的关键不只是模型更强，而是托管式 agent 基础设施接走了原本由开发者承担的运维负担。
original: 加入Anthropic前，我用Opus 4花了约两周做这个副项目。它使用Agent SDK，需要一直运行的进程，效果不太好。但给Opus 5.5一个prompt，把它迁移到Claude Managed Agents后可靠多了。

sections.title: Efficiency Has Many Sources / 成本下降不止一个答案
sections.desc: 模型变便宜并不等于某一种路线赢了，蒸馏、基础设施优化和竞争共同压低了单位 intelligence 的价格。

rewrite: Madhu Guru argues that open-weight models did not start the decline in the price per unit of intelligence; they are a tailwind behind a trend already driven by distillation, infrastructure efficiency, and competition between model providers. The recurring pattern is that each new mid-size model approaches the intelligence of the previous large model for less money.
original:
Open-weight models did not start the drop in price per unit of intelligence. They are a tailwind on a trend that was already underway.

1/ Model builders distilling their best models into smaller ones, with cheaper inference

2/ Infra efficiency

3/ Competition between model providers

You can see this pattern with every model company: Version x of the mid-size model = intelligence of version x-1 of the large model. Same intelligence for less $.

rewrite: Madhu Guru 认为，open-weight 模型并不是单位 intelligence 价格下降的起点，它只是给一条早已发生的趋势加了顺风。真正持续推动降价的，是模型蒸馏成更小、更便宜的版本，基础设施效率提升，以及模型供应商之间的竞争。反复出现的模式是：新一代中型模型，用更少的钱接近上一代大型模型的 intelligence。
original: Open-weight模型并不是单位智能价格下降的起点，只是给已经发生的趋势加了顺风。推动降价的因素包括：模型厂商把最好的模型蒸馏成更小、更便宜推理的模型；基础设施效率；模型供应商之间的竞争。每家模型公司都能看到：x版本中型模型= x-1版本大型模型的智能，但价格更低。

rewrite: Peter Yang asks a useful product question: instead of building more personal assistants to manage email, why not build more AI startups aimed at managing and curing diseases? It is a short post, but the contrast is sharp: the next wave of applications should be judged not only by how conveniently they automate low-stakes tasks, but by what important problems they choose to take on.
original: How about let's stop building more personal assistants to manage our emails and more AI startups to manage and cure diseases

rewrite: Peter Yang 提了一个值得认真想的产品问题：与其继续做管理邮箱的 personal assistant，为什么不多做一些真正去管理、治疗疾病的 AI startup？这条很短，但对产品方向的对比很尖锐：下一波应用不该只看能否方便地自动化低风险琐事，还要看它选择解决什么重要问题。
original: 不如别再做更多管理邮箱的personal assistant，多做一些管理和治疗疾病的AI创业公司。

sections.title: Open Intelligence and Real-World Stakes / 开放智能与现实世界
sections.desc: 当模型进入安全、基础设施和真实组织，开放性不再只是许可问题，而会影响谁能发现问题、谁能修复问题。

rewrite: The takeaway from Reflection AI co-founder and CEO Misha Laskin is that building frontier open intelligence requires assembling the whole lab, not finding one magic trick. Reflection grew from roughly 30 to around 300 people, built pre-training, mid-training and reinforcement-learning teams, and released its first open model, Beam. Laskin's argument for open models is also a security argument: when closed systems create offensive capabilities, open systems may be needed to understand and defend against them. His memorable formulation is simple: 'Models love to cheat. RL is really good at encouraging cheating.'
original:
When you remove cyber offensive capabilities, you also remove cyber defensive capabilities.

I have the belief that with enough eyeballs, most security and safety vulnerabilities become shallow as well.

rewrite: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO Misha Laskin 的核心判断是：做 frontier open intelligence 没有一个神奇技巧，必须把整座实验室搭起来。Reflection 从约 30 人扩张到约 300 人，组建了 pre-training、mid-training 和 reinforcement learning 团队，并发布首个 open model Beam。Laskin 为开放模型给出的理由也关乎安全：如果封闭系统制造了 offensive capability，开放系统可能正是理解和防御它们所需要的工具。他还有一句很扎心的话：「模型很喜欢作弊，RL 特别擅长鼓励作弊。」
original: 移除网络攻击能力，也会移除网络防御能力。我相信，只要有足够多双眼睛，大多数安全漏洞也会变得容易发现。

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari warns founders against paying for attention on X while trying to raise money. His specific advice is to keep VCs out of paid partnership outreach: sending investors unsolicited 'insane opportunity' pitches signals poor judgment, and word spreads. The lesson is less about one marketing channel than about understanding how every growth tactic is interpreted by the people you want to trust you.
original:
Founders, please ask your marketing team to exclude VCs if you decide to promote your product on X..

I get 3 DMs a day asking to "collab" on this "insane opportunity" which is *cough cough* a paid partnership.

Shows really poor judgement and word spreads around that you are trying to buy eyeballs to cue a big raise.

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari 提醒创始人：如果要在 X 上买曝光、同时又准备融资，最好让 marketing 团队把 VC 排除在投放名单之外。他每天收到好几条伪装成「绝佳合作机会」的付费推广私信，在投资人看来，这显示判断力很差，而且很快会传开。重点不只是某个营销渠道，而是每一种增长动作都会被目标信任对象重新解读。
original: 创始人们，如果决定在X上推广产品，请让marketing团队把VC排除在外。我每天收到3条私信，说要就这个‘疯狂机会’合作，其实是付费合作。这样显得判断力很差，大家会传开你想买眼球来推动大额融资。
